description: Wrenchli is a free AI-powered vehicle symptom assessment platform for vehicle owners across the United States. Describe a vehicle's symptoms and get likely causes with probability scores, an urgency level, a fair cost range, and questions to ask a mechanic. An assessment is a preliminary symptom analysis, not a professional inspection, and Wrenchli is not a licensed mechanic.
name: Wrenchli

skills.description: Offered as the assess_vehicle_symptoms tool on Wrenchli's MCP server (see x-mcp below). Takes a vehicle's year, make, and model plus a list of symptoms, and returns likely causes with probability scores, an urgency level (immediate, soon, schedule, or monitor), a fair cost range, and questions to ask a mechanic. Free, and no account is required.
skills.name: Assess vehicle symptoms
